speak.voice: Good morning. How can I help you today?
Good morning doctor. I have been experiencing some stomach pain for the past few days.
Can you describe the pain? Where exactly is it located?
It is in my upper abdomen, more on the right side. It gets worse after eating.
Do you have any other symptoms like nausea or vomiting?
Yes, I feel nauseous sometimes, especially after meals.
Based on your symptoms, this could be gastritis. I will prescribe some medication and recommend avoiding spicy and fatty foods.
Thank you doctor. How long should I take the medication?
Take the medication for one week. If symptoms persist, please come back for a follow-up.
